name: whatran
description: What ran? Record an agent's scientific analysis as a checkable Analysis Graph, then package the final path so it reruns and checks on a fresh clone.

interface.shortDescription: Record what ran, then package the final path so it reruns and checks.
interface.longDescription: Whatran has two skills. record-analysis keeps an append-only ledger of what the agent actually executed and compiles it into a result-centric graph of artifacts, runs and claims, with every run graded observed or declared and every file checked for integrity. package-analysis turns the final reported path into a normal GitHub repository that reruns from declared inputs, compares regenerated outputs with committed references on a fresh CI clone, and publishes a result-first page. Only a passed replay marks a run as reproducible.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $record-analysis while analysing, then $package-analysis to package the final path as a reproducible GitHub repository.
